paragraphs: I am Lily. This is my week at school. On Monday, we have music. We sing at nine o'clock. Teacher Kim plays the piano. It is my favorite lesson. We sing a happy song. On Tuesday, we have a number lesson. We count to twenty. Leo likes numbers. On Wednesday, we have a drawing lesson. I draw a big red flower.

On Thursday, the book room is open. We go there at ten o'clock. The room is small and nice. We read a book. Mia likes books about animals. On Friday, we have a sports lesson. We play football at two o'clock. Leo kicks the ball. Then we drink water. We are very happy.

From Monday to Friday, we eat lunch at twelve o'clock. I eat rice and eggs. I drink milk. On Saturday and Sunday, we are at home. I like my school week. What do you eat for lunch? What is your favorite lesson?
text.summary: Lily tells us about her school week. She has music, numbers, a book room, and football on different days, and she eats lunch at twelve o'clock.
